## Owner-approved scope

- Milestone or infrastructure task and authorization reference
- Summary and files changed

## Verification

- Focused and full offline test commands and results
- Acceptance checks and remaining blockers
- GO or NO-GO recommendation

## Owner review

- [ ] Private artifacts, credentials, and local data are excluded.
- [ ] This change preserves offline operation and stays within the approved scope.

Milestone acceptance and merge require a separate owner decision.
